text:
María (sales): Heads up — ACME GmbH (DE) says their purchases should be reverse-charged, sent VAT ID DE123456789. They want a reissue without VAT.
Liam (finance): I just checked VIES and that ID comes back invalid. Can you ask them for a screenshot of their VIES result + company registration?
Sam (acct exec): They attached a PDF that says VAT ID DE123456789 but no VIES screenshot. PDF is from their AP team, looks legit-ish. Sending link: https://files.acme.example/invoice_0424.pdf
TaxBot: VIES check result for DE123456789 — STATUS: INVALID (checked 2024-06-24 10:02 UTC) — http://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/checkVatService.wsdl
María (sales): pinged them and requested VIES screenshot and their commercial register excerpt. They replied they use an agent and provided an agent tax reg number instead — sounds messy.
Liam (finance): Important: if we can't validate a VAT ID we must charge VAT. We need evidence that buyer is a taxable person (B2B) and a valid VAT number.
Priya (legal): Also confirm billing address country. For reverse charge we need: buyer VAT ID valid in VIES, buyer name/address on file, and wording on invoice like "reverse charge — Article 193" or local equivalent. If they provide only agent ID, ask for principal's details.
Nora (payments): If we reissue without VAT and it's later found invalid, we'll have to issue a corrected invoice and collect VAT — pain. Can we hold off credits until they provide VIES screenshot?
Sam (acct exec): Customer is pushing for month-end close. Their AP says they can provide a signed declaration that they're a taxable business. Would that satisfy you?
Liam (finance): Signed declaration alone isn't enough for EU B2B reverse charge. VIES + company registration excerpt preferred. If they cannot provide VIES-valid VAT ID, we must include VAT.
María (sales): I'll escalate to their VP of Finance and ask for: 1) VIES validation screenshot 2) company registration excerpt 3) confirmation of business billing address.
Priya (legal): Also request their tax jurisdiction (DE vs other) and if they use any OSS/marketplace rules. Ask them to confirm they are not a consumer.
Sam (acct exec): Noted. I'll offer to expedite reissue once we have docs. If they push, we can offer provisional invoice with VAT, then credit later pending proof.
Liam (finance): Agreed. Nora — hold any credit/zero-VAT reissue until we have docs.
Nora (payments): Holding. I'll flag in billing system: "DO NOT RE-ISSUE VAT-EXEMPT INVOICE UNTIL VALIDATION RECEIVED".
María (sales): update from customer: attached screenshot of VIES lookup — it shows "No match found" but their AP says it's a formatting issue. They provided their company number HRB-12345.
Priya (legal): HRB is German commercial register number — ask for the Handelsregister excerpt (signed) and a matching company name/address. Then run VIES lookup again with exact official name.
Liam (finance): Thanks. Action items: María to get Handelsregister excerpt + exact legal name; Sam to offer provisional VAT-charged invoice if they need close; Nora to hold reissue.
María (sales): Will do. I'll update thread when I have docs. :thumbsup:
TaxBot: Reminder — VIES sometimes has propagation delays. If they claim recent registration, ask for date of VAT activation.
Sam (acct exec): FYI customer suggested they can provide W-8/W-9 — told them that's US-only and irrelevant here. :)
Liam (finance): Good catch. Keep me posted.
María (sales): Closing loop: customer sent Handelsregister excerpt and new VIES screenshot — it now validates DE123456789 (checked 2024-06-24 15:36 UTC). Please reissue invoice net of VAT with reverse-charge note.
Nora (payments): Reissue queued. Adding note: "Reverse charge — customer provided VIES validation and Handelsregister excerpt on 2024-06-24."
Liam (finance): Once reissued, log evidence in tax folder and add copy to billing record. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
